summary: IREN Ltd filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary IE US Hardware 4 Inc. entered a $1.6 billion GPU purchase agreement with Dell Marketing L.P. for deployment at its Childress, Texas campus to service a previously announced $3.4 billion AI cloud contract. The filing describes a routine supply agreement with customary terms and a parent guarantee. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The filing is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement.
